```{r setup, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, include=FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
library(lme4)
library(lmerTest)
library(emmeans)
library(patchwork)

main_path <- getwd()
data_path <- file.path(main_path, "data/cleaned_data")
study_1_path <- file.path(main_path, "study_1")
figure_path <- file.path(study_1_path, "figures")

set.seed(7386)

demographics <- read_csv(file.path(data_path, "demographics.csv"), show_col_types = FALSE)
sound_events <- read_csv(file.path(data_path, "sound_events.csv"), show_col_types = FALSE)
roundwise_clean <- read_csv(file.path(data_path, "roundwise_clean.csv"), show_col_types = FALSE)

source(file.path(main_path, "overall_functions.R"))
```

## Identify the no-press dyads

```{r}
# Full analytic Study 1 sample
dem_coop_analytic <- demographics %>%
  filter(
    !excluded,
    setup == "COOP"
  )

analytic_coop_ids <- dem_coop_analytic %>%
  distinct(id)

sound_coop_analytic <- sound_events %>%
  filter(setup == "COOP") %>%
  semi_join(analytic_coop_ids, by = "id")

# Dyads in which neither participant pressed during any sound event
no_press_dyads <- sound_coop_analytic %>%
  group_by(id) %>%
  summarise(
    n_female_presses = sum(
      responder_gender == "Female",
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),
    n_male_presses = sum(
      responder_gender == "Male",
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),
    n_no_press_events = sum(
      responder_gender == "none",
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),
    n_presses = n_female_presses + n_male_presses,
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  filter(n_presses == 0)

no_press_dyads
nrow(no_press_dyads)
```

```{r}
# Participants and rounds from the no-press dyads
dem_no_press <- dem_coop_analytic %>%
  semi_join(no_press_dyads, by = "id")

no_press_rounds <- roundwise_clean %>%
  filter(
    !excluded,
    setup == "COOP"
  ) %>%
  semi_join(no_press_dyads, by = "id")
```

## Derive performance and sound variables

```{r}
no_press_rounds <- no_press_rounds %>%
  mutate(
    gender = factor(
      gender,
      levels = c("Female", "Male")
    ),
    completed = as.integer(completed),
    success = as.integer(success),
    skipped = as.integer(completed == 0),
    secs = as.numeric(secs),
    log_secs = log(secs + 1),
    n_sound_episodes = replace_na(n_sound_episodes, 0),
    any_sound = as.integer(
      replace_na(any_stimulus, FALSE)
    )
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    sound1_lower = str_to_lower(
      coalesce(sound1_stimulus, "")
    ),
    sound2_lower = str_to_lower(
      coalesce(sound2_stimulus, "")
    ),
    sound3_lower = str_to_lower(
      coalesce(sound3_stimulus, "")
    ),
    any_cry = as.integer(
      str_detect(sound1_lower, "cry|cries") |
        str_detect(sound2_lower, "cry|cries") |
        str_detect(sound3_lower, "cry|cries")
    ),
    any_alarm = as.integer(
      str_detect(sound1_lower, "alarm") |
        str_detect(sound2_lower, "alarm") |
        str_detect(sound3_lower, "alarm")
    ),
    round_sound_type = case_when(
      any_sound == 0 ~ "none",
      any_cry == 1 & any_alarm == 0 ~ "cry_only",
      any_cry == 0 & any_alarm == 1 ~ "alarm_only",
      any_cry == 1 & any_alarm == 1 ~ "mixed_cry_alarm",
      TRUE ~ "unclear"
    ),
    round_sound_type = factor(
      round_sound_type,
      levels = c(
        "none",
        "alarm_only",
        "cry_only",
        "mixed_cry_alarm",
        "unclear"
      )
    )
  )

# Retain the sound conditions represented in the no-press dyads
# Exclude mixed cry-alarm rounds
no_press_rounds <- no_press_rounds %>%
  filter(round_sound_type != "mixed_cry_alarm")
```

## Participant-level task-performance descriptives

```{r}
no_press_participant_performance <- no_press_rounds %>%
  group_by(
    id,
    participant.code,
    gender
  ) %>%
  summarise(
    n_matrices_seen = n(),
    n_matrices_completed = sum(
      completed,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),
    n_matrices_correct = sum(
      success,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),
    n_matrices_skip = sum(
      skipped,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),
    mean_round_duration_secs = mean(
      secs,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),
    n_rounds_with_any_sound = sum(
      any_sound,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),
    n_rounds_with_more_than_one_sound = sum(
      n_sound_episodes > 1,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

no_press_participant_performance %>%
  summarise(
    n_participants = n(),

    mean_matrices_seen =
      mean(n_matrices_seen, na.rm = TRUE),

    round_duration_mean =
```

## Paired gender comparisons of participant-level performance

```{r}
no_press_performance_wide <- no_press_participant_performance %>%
  dplyr::select(
    id,
    gender,
    n_matrices_seen,
    n_matrices_completed,
    n_matrices_correct,
    mean_round_duration_secs
  ) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = gender,
    values_from = c(
      n_matrices_seen,
      n_matrices_completed,
      n_matrices_correct,
      mean_round_duration_secs
    )
  )

no_press_difference_scores <- no_press_performance_wide %>%
  transmute(
    id,
    matrices_seen_diff =
      n_matrices_seen_Female -
      n_matrices_seen_Male,
    matrices_answered_diff =
      n_matrices_completed_Female -
      n_matrices_completed_Male,
    matrices_correct_diff =
      n_matrices_correct_Female -
      n_matrices_correct_Male,
    mean_duration_diff =
      mean_round_duration_secs_Female -
      mean_round_duration_secs_Male
  )

no_press_difference_scores_long <-
  no_press_difference_scores %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = -id,
    names_to = "outcome",
    values_to = "difference"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    outcome = factor(
      outcome,
      levels = c(
        "matrices_seen_diff",
        "matrices_answered_diff",
        "matrices_correct_diff",
        "mean_duration_diff"
      ),
      labels = c(
        "Matrices seen",
        "Matrices answered",
        "Matrices correct",
        "Mean round duration"
      )
    )
  )
```

```{r}
# Distributional checks of within-dyad difference scores
# Boxplots of within-dyad difference scores
p_no_press_difference_boxplots <-
  ggplot(

plot_png_path <- file.path(
```

## Duration model fitted to answered rounds

```{r}
duration_data <- no_press_rounds %>%
  filter(
    completed == 1,
    round_sound_type %in% c(
      "none",
      "cry_only"
    ),
    !is.na(log_secs),
    !is.na(gender),
    !is.na(participant.code),
    !is.na(id)
  ) %>%
  droplevels() %>%
  mutate(
    gender = relevel(
      gender,
      ref = "Female"
    ),
    round_sound_type = relevel(
      round_sound_type,
      ref = "none"
    )
  )

duration_data %>%
  count(
    gender,
    round_sound_type
  )

duration_data %>%
  summarise(
    n_rounds = n(),
    n_dyads = n_distinct(id),
    n_participants =
      n_distinct(participant.code)
  )
```

```{r}
# Raw and log-transformed duration distributions
duration_dist_df <- duration_data %>%
  dplyr::select(secs, log_secs) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(secs, log_secs),
    names_to = "scale",
    values_to = "duration"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    scale = factor(
      scale,
      levels = c("secs", "log_secs"),
      labels = c(
        "Raw round duration",
        "Log-transformed round duration"
      )
    )
  )

p_no_press_duration_distributions <-
  ggplot(
    duration_dist_df,
    aes(x = duration)
  ) +
  geom_histogram(
    bins = 30
  ) +
  facet_wrap(
    ~ scale,
    scales = "free_x",
    ncol = 2
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  labs(
    x = NULL,
    y = "Count"
  ) +
  theme(
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    strip.text = element_text(face = "bold")
  )

plot_png_path <- file.path(
    figure_path,
    "s1_no_press_duration_raw_log_distributions.png"
  )
show_or_save_ggplot(
  plot_png_path = plot_png_path,
  plot_object = p_no_press_duration_distributions,
  width = 10,
  height = 5,
  dpi = 300
)

```

```{r}
# The dyad random intercept accounts for dependence between partners.
duration_model <- lmer(
  log_secs ~
    round_sound_type * gender +
    (1 | id) +
    (1 | participant.code),
  data = duration_data,
  REML = TRUE
)

summary(duration_model)

duration_summary <- coef(summary(duration_model))

cbind(
  Estimate = duration_summary[, "Estimate"],
  lower_95_CI =
    duration_summary[, "Estimate"] -
    qt(0.975, duration_summary[, "df"]) *
    duration_summary[, "Std. Error"],
  upper_95_CI =
    duration_summary[, "Estimate"] +
    qt(0.975, duration_summary[, "df"]) *
    duration_summary[, "Std. Error"]
)
```

## Estimated sound-condition contrasts

```{r}
# Estimated cry-versus-no-sound contrast within each gender
duration_emmeans <- emmeans(
  duration_model,
  ~ round_sound_type | gender,
  lmer.df = "satterthwaite"
)

duration_sound_contrasts <- contrast(
  duration_emmeans,
  method = list(
    "cry_only - none" = c(-1, 1)
  )
)

summary(
  duration_sound_contrasts,
  infer = c(TRUE, TRUE),
  adjust = "none"
)

duration_gender_interaction <- contrast(
  duration_sound_contrasts,
  method = "revpairwise",
  by = NULL
)

summary(
  duration_gender_interaction,
  infer = c(TRUE, TRUE),
  adjust = "none"
)
```

## Duration-model diagnostics

```{r}
duration_data %>%
  summarise(
    n_rounds = n(),
    n_dyads = n_distinct(id),
    n_participants =
      n_distinct(participant.code),
    min_secs = min(secs, na.rm = TRUE),
    max_secs = max(secs, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_zero_secs = sum(secs == 0, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_negative_secs = sum(secs < 0, na.rm = TRUE)
  )

duration_data %>%
  count(
    participant.code,
    gender,
    name = "n_rounds"
  ) %>%
  summarise(
    min_rounds = min(n_rounds),
    median_rounds = median(n_rounds),
    mean_rounds = mean(n_rounds),
    max_rounds = max(n_rounds)
  )

isSingular(
  duration_model,
  tol = 1e-4
)

VarCorr(duration_model)

duration_model@optinfo$conv$lme4$messages

fixed_effect_matrix <- getME(
  duration_model,
  "X"
)

c(
  number_of_columns =
    ncol(fixed_effect_matrix),
  matrix_rank =
    qr(fixed_effect_matrix)$rank
)
```

```{r}
duration_diagnostics <- tibble(
  fitted = fitted(duration_model),
  residual = resid(duration_model),
  standardised_residual =
    resid(duration_model) / sigma(duration_model)
)

# Residuals versus fitted values
p_duration_residuals_fitted <-
  ggplot(
    duration_diagnostics,
    aes(
      x = fitted,
      y = standardised_residual
    )
  ) +
  geom_point(
    alpha = 0.45,
    size = 1.3
  ) +
  geom_hline(
    yintercept = 0,
    linetype = 2
  ) +
  geom_hline(
    yintercept = c(-2, 2),
    linetype = 3
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "A.",
    x = "Fitted log duration",
    y = "Standardised residual"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
  )

# Normal Q-Q plot
p_duration_residual_qq <-
  ggplot(
    duration_diagnostics,
    aes(sample = standardised_residual)
  ) +
  stat_qq(
    alpha = 0.50,
    size = 1.3
  ) +
  stat_qq_line(
    linewidth = 0.7
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "B.",
    x = "Theoretical quantiles",
    y = "Observed quantiles"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
  )

# Histogram of standardised residuals
p_duration_residual_histogram <-
  ggplot(
    duration_diagnostics,
    aes(x = standardised_residual)
  ) +
  geom_histogram(
    bins = 30,
    boundary = 0
  ) +
  geom_vline(
    xintercept = 0,
    linetype = 2
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "C.",
    x = "Standardised residual",
    y = "Count"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
  )

p_no_press_duration_diagnostics <-
  p_duration_residuals_fitted /
  (p_duration_residual_qq +
     p_duration_residual_histogram) +
  plot_layout(
    heights = c(1, 1)
  )

plot_png_path <- file.path(
    figure_path,
    "s1_no_press_duration_model_diagnostics.png"
  )
show_or_save_ggplot(
  plot_png_path = plot_png_path,
  plot_object = p_no_press_duration_diagnostics,
  width = 11,
  height = 9,
  dpi = 300
)
```

## Duration figure

```{r}
# Participant-level mean log durations
duration_participant_log_means <- duration_data %>%
  group_by(
    participant.code,
    gender,
    round_sound_type
  ) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_log_secs =
      mean(log_secs, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    gender = factor(
      gender,
      levels = c(
        "Female",
        "Male"
      )
    ),
    round_sound_type = factor(
      round_sound_type,
      levels = c(
        "none",
        "cry_only"
      ),
      labels = c(
        "No sound",
        "Infant cry"
      )
    )
  )

# Model-estimated means
duration_emmeans_plot <- summary(
  duration_emmeans,
  infer = c(TRUE, TRUE)
) %>%
  as_tibble() %>%
  mutate(
    gender = factor(
      gender,
      levels = c(
        "Female",
        "Male"
      )
    ),
    round_sound_type = factor(
      round_sound_type,
      levels = c(
        "none",
        "cry_only"
      ),
      labels = c(
        "No sound",
        "Infant cry"
      )
    )
  )

# Cry-minus-no-sound contrasts within each gender
duration_contrast_plot <- 
  summary(
    duration_sound_contrasts,
    infer = c(TRUE, TRUE),
    adjust = "none"
  ) %>%
  as_tibble() %>%
  mutate(
    gender = factor(
      gender,
      levels = c("Female", "Male")
    ),
    contrast_label = "Infant cry versus no sound"
  )


gender_colours <- c(
  "Female" = "#2A9D8F",
  "Male" = "#eb8005"
)

duration_dodge <-
  position_dodge(width = 0.78)
```

```{r}
p_no_press_duration_means <- 
  ggplot(
    duration_participant_log_means,
    aes(
      x = round_sound_type,
      y = mean_log_secs,
      fill = gender,
      colour = gender
    )
  ) +
  geom_violin(
    aes(
      group = interaction(
        round_sound_type,
        gender
      )
    ),
    position = duration_dodge,
    width = 0.70,
    scale = "width",
    trim = FALSE,
    alpha = 0.10,
    linewidth = 0.55
  ) +
  geom_point(
    position = position_jitterdodge(
      jitter.width = 0.07,
      jitter.height = 0,
      dodge.width = 0.78
    ),
    size = 1.7,
    alpha = 0.40
  ) +
  geom_errorbar(
    data = duration_emmeans_plot,
    aes(
      x = round_sound_type,
      ymin = lower.CL,
      ymax = upper.CL,
      colour = gender
    ),
    position = duration_dodge,
    width = 0.10,
    linewidth = 0.9,
    inherit.aes = FALSE
  ) +
  geom_point(
    data = duration_emmeans_plot,
    aes(
      x = round_sound_type,
      y = emmean,
      colour = gender
    ),
    position = duration_dodge,
    size = 3.2,
    inherit.aes = FALSE
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = gender_colours
  ) +
  scale_colour_manual(
    values = gender_colours
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "A.",
    x = NULL,
    y = "Log-transformed answered-round duration",
    fill = "Gender",
    colour = "Gender"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    panel.grid.minor =
      element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major.x =
      element_blank(),
    legend.position = "top",
    legend.title =
      element_blank()
  )
```

```{r}
p_no_press_duration_contrasts <- ggplot(
  duration_contrast_plot,
  aes(
    x = estimate,
    y = contrast_label,
    colour = gender
  )
) +
  geom_vline(
    xintercept = 0,
    linetype = 2,
    linewidth = 0.7
  ) +
  geom_errorbar(
    aes(
      xmin = lower.CL,
      xmax = upper.CL
    ),
    position = position_dodge(width = 0.45),
    width = 0,
    linewidth = 0.9,
    orientation = "y"
  ) +
  geom_point(
    position = position_dodge(width = 0.45),
    size = 3.2
  ) +
  scale_colour_manual(
    values = gender_colours
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "B.",
    x = "Estimated difference in log-transformed round duration",
    y = "Infant cry versus no sound",
    colour = "Gender"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),
    legend.position = "none",

    # Remove the horizontal category label only
    axis.text.y = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks.y = element_blank(),

    # Keep the vertical y-axis title
    axis.title.y = element_text(
      margin = margin(r = 10)
    )
  )
```
